mapper.select: SELECT bdi.BOOKSET_ID booksetId, fintp.PRIN feeAmtDetail, bdi.TRADE_ID busiId, bdi.BUSI_DETAIL_TYPE busiDetailType, bdi.BOK_DETAIL_ID bokDetailId FROM BOK_BATCH_TASK_TODO A INNER JOIN BOK_DETAIL_ID bdi ON A.BOOKSET_ID = bdi.BOOKSET_ID INNER JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT fintp ON fintp.FINPROD_ID = bdi.TRADE_ID WHERE fintp.BRANCH = 0 AND to_char(fintp.VDATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') <= to_char(#{BOOK_DATE,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-mm-dd') AND to_char(fintp.MDATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') > to_char(#{BOOK_DATE,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-mm-dd') and A.SEQ_NO = #{seqNo} AND A.BOOKSET_DATE = #{BOOKSET_DATE} AND A.BOOK_DATE = #{BOOK_DATE} AND A.HAPPEN_DATE = #{HAPPEN_DATE} AND A.TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND A.IS_SUB_BOOKSET = '02'
